items.title: Vivian & Frank visit Noor
lines: A coffee farm with no website, no phone line, no internet.
A friend said: you can only go by luck.
items.foot: WeKaribu · Hack-Nation × World Bank · Small AI for Development · Tourism

dialogue.text: Emma said you can't book Noor's farm. No website, no phone line. You can only go by luck.
Unless Emma used WeKaribu. Give it a go.
I'll just type what Emma told us.
Best match: Noor's farm. Wednesday's free. Two of us, and mention Emma.
Deposit by M-Pesa, straight to Noor's phone. Done.
Noor gets our request and taps Accept. Her call, not the app's.
After the visit she photographs the guestbook: a German page, a French voice note, read on her phone, offline.
Ten fixed topics, good or bad. Anything unsure is marked for a person.
And the summary is human-written Swahili the AI only fills in. She can even listen to it.
Then a thank-you came, in English, because we ticked yes.
Sent only when Noor tapped send. WeKaribu: we welcome.
